kind_why: A combat surf map: buyzones and bomb sites, 14 spawns a side, every teleport back to a spawn or the top of the course. 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.

sealed_teleports.note: The catch-all teleports aimed at ct_spawn and t_spawn drop a faller into the two team spawn rooms, which a faller cannot leave (about 8 m of reach: found by game-arena's headless_imported fall-out walk, pits 6 and 1); the importer runs no outputs. Dropped, a fall is the map's own drop back into the fight, and the b_site and top teleports stay.
